summary: Built Slash Command Center modal for iHIM. Displays all 5 existing commands (/save, /endsession, /audit, /push-workspace, /meeting-prep) with full descriptions, category grouping, tags, and search. Includes brainstorm section for saving new command ideas to localStorage.

components_added.name: Slash Command Center Modal
components_added.description: Full-featured modal with search, categorized command display, and brainstorm section

ui_elements_added: slash-search - Search input for filtering commands
slash-list - Command list grouped by category
slash-brainstorm - Section for saving new command ideas
slash-ideas - List of saved brainstorm ideas (localStorage)
features_implemented: Display all 5 existing commands with full descriptions
Search/filter functionality (searches name, title, description, tags)
Brainstorm section for new command ideas
design_patterns_followed: Consistent modal structure with other iHIM modals
Category-colored left border on command cards
handoff_notes: Slash Command Center is a frontend-only feature. Commands are hardcoded in JavaScript to match the harness/commands/ files. If new commands are added to harness/commands/, they should also be added to the slashCommands array in index.html. Future enhancement: Could fetch commands dynamically from an API endpoint.
recommendations: Consider adding an API endpoint to read harness/commands/ dynamically
Could add 'auto-trigger' badge for commands that can be invoked via hooks
Could add a 'last used' timestamp for frequently used commands
Consider keyboard shortcuts (e.g., Ctrl+K to open command center)
